holder_request.summary: 주주는 경영진 보상에 대한 투표를 통해 주주 가치를 보호하고자 한다.

evidence.quote: we are seeking an advisory, non-binding shareholder vote with respect to compensation awarded to our named executive officers.

company_response.summary: 회사는 보상이 성과 기반으로 설계되었으며, 주주와의 이해관계를 일치시키기 위해 노력하고 있다고 주장한다.

evidence.quote: We believe in pay for performance, which is reflected in our compensation design.
The proportion of overall pay tied to performance is higher for employees at more senior levels in the organization.
the design of our annual and long-term incentives focuses performance on long-term value creation and discourages short-term risk taking.
the majority of compensation provided to our named executive officers is delivered through equity awards, with payout based on long-term company performance.
the Compensation Committee reviewed a comprehensive annual evaluation conducted by Alphabet management of all our 2025 compensation programs.

vote_opinion.reason: 회사가 성과 기반 보상을 주장하지만, 주주가치 보호에 대한 구체적인 증거가 부족하다.

evidence.quote: this vote is advisory, it will not be binding upon our Board.
